A battle-mage's fireball bursting in a roiling orange bloom over the enemy ranks, bodies flung outward, the blast lighting the smoke.
The sky momentarily black with a massed volley of arrows arcing over the lines before falling like deadly rain.
Catapult-stones smashing down into the packed front line, throwing up gouts of dirt, splintered shields and tumbling figures.
War-banners of a dozen factions streaming above the melee, bright against the smoke, marking the churning heart of the slaughter.
A wall of magical fire erupting across the field, splitting the armies apart, the roaring curtain casting hellish orange light over everything.
Trebuchets hurling flaming payloads in long arcs, the burning bundles trailing black smoke before detonating among the tightly packed formations below.
A glowing magical ward flaring brilliant white under the impact of a sorcerer's bolt, cracks spreading through the shimmering barrier like broken ice.
Explosions of dirt, stone and broken bodies erupting along the line as siege-stones walk in a terrible pattern through the ranks.
A sorcerer raising both arms as lightning forks down from a darkened sky, walking in blinding branches through the advancing enemy column.
Burning oil pouring in gleaming sheets from the battlements, igniting on impact, washing the base of the walls in roaring blue-orange flame.
A holy radiance breaking over the front line, golden light blazing outward from a war-priest's raised staff, driving shadows and fear before it.
Ballista bolts streaking flat across the field, each one punching through shields and armor alike, pinning men to the earth in their path.
A dragon descending in a long screaming dive, its breath weapon a sustained torrent of white fire sweeping the length of the siege lines.
A summoned earth elemental rising from the ground beneath an enemy formation, hurling boulders and soldiers skyward with tremendous heaving blows.
Chain-shot from a heavy ballista spinning end over end through a cavalry charge, scything horses and riders down in a single brutal sweep.
A necromancer's dark pulse rolling outward across the battlefield, the fallen twitching and rising behind their own lines in a horrifying second wave.
Smoke-columns from a dozen burning siege engines rising into the overcast sky, the entire field obscured in drifting grey and oily black clouds.
A magical vortex conjured above the melee, pulling loose weapons, banners and screaming soldiers upward into its spinning funnel of crackling violet energy.
Grappling hooks and siege ladders slamming against the walls simultaneously along a hundred-yard front, soldiers swarming upward through a storm of dropped stones.
A frost sorcerer's blizzard-cone freezing the foremost ranks solid in an instant, the sudden crystalline wall of immobilized soldiers shattering under the next volley.
Signal horns and drums erupting across the field as a flanking force breaks cover, thousands of spears catching the pale light as they charge.
A magical implosion collapsing a section of castle wall inward, the stones folding like crushed parchment into the purple-black sphere before erupting outward.
Flaming arrows from ten thousand bows launched simultaneously, the arc of fire overhead turning the smoke-laden sky into a cathedral of burning light.
A war-golem thirty feet tall wading through the tightest part of the line, each impact of its stone fists sending men cartwheeling through the air.
The river itself redirected by a water-mage's desperate working, a brown churning wall sweeping across the low ground and swallowing an entire brigade whole.
